plugins.name: content-design
plugins.description: The content-design role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 문구가 사용자의 실제 결정을 돕는가.

plugins.name: content-design-phase1-basis
plugins.description: Gate: phase-1 content-design proposal must rest on a stated survey+scout basis (or documented skip per the standing scout-directive).

plugins.name: content-design-decision-rationale
plugins.description: Gate: decision-tied rationale — phase-1 proposal (one basis-level statement) and phase-2 record ([decision] -> [why] per copy string), same script branching on mode.

plugins.name: content-design-tone-axis
plugins.description: Gate: NN Group 4-axis tone check per copy string in the phase-2 content-design record, present-or-skipped-with-reason.

plugins.name: content-design-ab-spec
plugins.description: Gate: testable A/B variant spec per copy string in the phase-2 content-design record — exactly one varied element + user-behavior signal, or not-applicable + reason.

plugins.name: content-design-self-critique
plugins.description: Gate: self-critique note per copy string in the phase-2 content-design record, present and ordered after the rationale/tone/A-B sections it checks.
